out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The EHS provided the PIC with a sign during the inspection.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device (thermometer) in three refrigeration units: 1) the dessert unit in the dining room, 2) the Avantco 3-door prep top unit, and 3) the 3-door Turbo Air M3 prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. The PIC ordered new thermometers for these units during the inspection. Please install them in these units when they are received.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the bottom of the back door. The bottom of the back door is severely deteriorated and when closed, has gaps large enough in it to allow pests to enter.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Please repair the bottom of the back door or replace it as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: an in-use spatula and pair of tongs was being stored in a stainless steel pan of standing 100º water on the grill.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. If you want to store utensils and standing water, the water must be 135°F at all times to PIC correct of this during the inspection. DELICIAS DE CENTRO AMÉRICA (Inspection Date: 09/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. There was no certified food manager present during today’s inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A certified food manager is required to be present during all hours of operation. The CFM arrived before the inspection concluded. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the handsink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw foods in the 2-drawer unit under the griddle were not being held at 41º and below. Chicken was 44º, beef chunks were 43º, chorizo was 43º, and flank steak was 44º. The holding temperature of the unit was 45º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC stated the foods had just been moved from the walk-in to the current unit. The holding temp of the unit lowered to 37º during the inspection. The food temps were decreasing during the inspection. Foods were placed in the walk-in freezer for 15 minutes to cool. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: corn elote, white rice, pig knuckles (all made yesterday), and beets were not date marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI. DELICIAS DE CENTRO AMÉRICA (Inspection Date: 03/20/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed an unlabeled spray bottle of bleach water near the food prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled the spray bottle during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: foods such as white rice, pig knuckles and refried beans placed in the walk-in to cool, were covered.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Do not cover cooling foods. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: The back door is not sealed properly to prevent pest entry.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: utensils were being stored in standing water (85º) on the griddle.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The water was 135º before the inspection concluded. CDI.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: refrigerator door handles had food debris built-up on them.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean the refrigerator door handles, especially where fingers contact them to pull the doors open as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed several holes in walls behind the 3-vat sink and the prep table near the back door where equipment was previously hung. These holes need to be e repaired as they are providing hiding places for roaches. The bottom of the back door is damaged and needs to be repaired it will allow pests to enter. There are two pieces of metal placed there, but they are not permanently attached.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Seal the holes and gaps in walls and repair the back door as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed a significant amount of roach droppings on the back wall where the electrical panel is and on the wall behind the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean these walls to remove the roach droppings as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. The certified food manager was not present when the inspection started.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. The food manager arrived after the inspection started. It is recommended that more staff become certified so that a food manager can be present during all hours of operation, as required.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' The manager did not have an employee health policy in place
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. The EHS provided the manager with the model FCHD employee health policy which the manager stated they would adopt. DELICIAS DE CENTRO AMÉRICA (Inspection Date: 09/22/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The manager did not have a vomit and diarrhea, cleanup kit nor a plan in place.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS provided the manager with the model FCHD clean up policy which the manager said they would adopt and implement.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Should employee handle raw chicken with glove hands, took off gloves to perform another task without washing hands first.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The EHS requested the food employee wash their hands which they did and discussed the importance of handwashing when changing tasks, especially from switching from raw food to cooked or ready to eat food.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There is no hand soap at the ceiling, kitchen hand sink. The food employee took hand soap from the guest restroom and placed it in the kitchen, so there was no hand soap in the guest restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The food employee placed hand soap in the guest restroom. Both handsinks had hand soap when the inspection is over.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no signage in the kitchen, hand sink advising employees to wash their hands. There was also no signage in the employee only restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Provide the appropriate signage before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. A covered 6 inch cambro container of rice cookie yesterday was 64° this morning. In the Avantco two door table top unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. The EHS discuss the importance of proper cooling with the food employee and the manager. The improperly cooled rice was discarded.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw chorizo meat, raw marinated beef and raw marinated chicken were being held at 45°F, 44°F, and 44°F, respectively in the Avantco four drawer refrigeration unit under the grill. This was observed during the last inspection as well.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The foods were all discarded. This refrigeration unit may need attention. It is recommended that it be checked and assessed by a qualified technician.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: the menu contains a dish with eggs cooked the order. There is a advisory statement at the bottom of the menu with an asterisk, but the menu item with eggs cooked to order did not have an asterisk.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. The EHS advised the manager to place an asterisk next to the eggs cooked to order menu item on each of the menus before the follow-up inspection on October 2, 2025.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles of condiments and dessert toppings were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. violations.corrective_action: No credits and manufacturers buckets are not approved for reuse for food storage. Remove all unapproved milk crates, and manufacturer buckets before the next routine inspection.
